Ivy: EdgeGrid (edge caching partner) asked for a marketplace "shim" repo + Terraform module to wire our inference container into their regional cache layer. Key asks: region-local cache config, optional CDN fronting, S3-backed KV fallback, ARM64 + x86 variants, and an ops playbook. They want a minimal example and smoke CI within 2 weeks. Who can own?
Ben: I can take the Terraform module. Plan: single module with `cache_mode = "regional" | "cdn"` and `hardware_tier = "arm64" | "x86"`. Will scaffold outputs for SKUs and an examples/quickstart.
Soraya: I'll draft the ops playbook and diagram (cache invalidation, health checks, GC policy). Ops items: TTL defaults, metrics to export (cache_hit, kv_fallback_rate), and a drain flow for rolling upgrades.
Lee: CI note 3 add `ci/marketplace-smoke.yml` that builds image, verifies SBOM, deploys ephemeral infra in partner account, runs `scripts/check_cache_integration.sh` which hits health endpoints and runs 20 sample generations, then tears down. I'll stub the GH action.
Ben: example usage I'll add: ```terraform
module "edgegrid_shim" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-shims/edgegrid"
  cache_mode = var.cache_mode # regional | cdn
  regions = ["us-west-2", "eu-central-1"]
  hardware_tier = var.hardware_tier # arm64 | x86
}
```
Ivy: EdgeGrid will provide signed OCI images and SBOMs. They asked we show a small "Redwood Verified" perf blurb (non-prod numbers only) in the README and link to our perf doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/perf.
Soraya: Security checklist I want in README: verify image signatures at deploy time, least-priv IAM for S3/KV, TLS mTLS between cache and containers, and KMS for keys.
Lee: Also add a smoke prompt set (10 prompts) for regression checks and a synthetic latency test. We'll gate marketplace publish on passing smoke CI.
onboard-bot: Created ticket P-4001: "EdgeGrid marketplace shim + cache integration module" assigned to @Ben and linked to partner-onboarding epic.
Ben: I'll open initial skeleton PR by EOD and include examples/minimal-client (curl + python). Can someone pair on the runbook review Thursday 9:30am PT?
Soraya: I'll join Thursday 9:30am PT. I'll prepare diagrams and a short drill script for failover.
Ivy: Thanks all 3 please add notes about any model-compat restrictions (sequence length, kv cache behavior) in the README so partners can set correct defaults.
Ben: Agree 3 will add `defaults.tfvars` with sane defaults and a small compatibility table.
Ivy: :thumbsup: Meeting invite incoming.
